Studio.title: Corral Studio
Studio.demoNote: Agents are simulated in your browser. No model or network calls are made.
Studio.notFoundCorral: This Corral does not exist in this browser.

Palette.heading: Nodes
Palette.hint: Drag a node onto the canvas, or use Add.
Palette.agentDescription: Does one task with a role and prompt
Palette.decisionDescription: Branches on a review verdict, an approval or a rule
Palette.loopDescription: Repeats the steps inside it up to a limit

Canvas.label: Corral canvas
Canvas.empty: Drop an Agent and an Output here, then connect them.
Canvas.loopMembers: {count, plural, =0 {empty} one {# step inside} other {# steps inside}} · up to {max} rounds

rejected.selfConnection: A node cannot connect to itself.
rejected.callableInControlFlow: Callable agents are not part of the flow. Use a delegate or ask link instead.
rejected.invalidSourcePort: That node has no such output.
rejected.invalidTargetPort: That node has no such input.
rejected.duplicateOutgoing: This output already leads somewhere. Delete that connection first.
rejected.loopBoundary: Connections cross a Loop only through its ports: enter, body, repeat, exit and next.
rejected.cycle: This connection would create a cycle. Repeat work with a Loop.
rejected.sourceNotAgent: Only agents can call other agents.
rejected.targetNotCallable: Calls go to callable agents. Set the target agent to Callable first.

Inspector.heading: Properties
Inspector.none: Select a node to edit it.
Inspector.label: Name
Inspector.sharedRole: This role is shared by {count} nodes. Changes apply to all of them.
Inspector.outputNote: The Output receives the version submitted by the agent connected into it.
Inspector.noCallableAgents: Add an agent and set it to Only when called.

Validation.heading: Before running
Validation.runtimeNote: This structure is valid, but this runtime runs only Agent → Output flows. Loops and decisions run from P2/P5.

codes.UNKNOWN_REFERENCE: Something refers to an item that does not exist.
codes.INVALID_PORT: This connection uses a port the node does not have.
codes.DUPLICATE_PORT_EDGE: An output leads to two places.
codes.CALLABLE_IN_CONTROL_FLOW: A callable agent is connected into the flow.
codes.ENTRY_INVALID: The flow must start at an agent outside any Loop.
codes.DEAD_END: This agent has no next step.
codes.DECISION_RULE: This decision's rule does not match its mode.
codes.DECISION_BRANCH_MISSING: A branch of this decision is not connected.
codes.LOOP_BOUNDARY: This connection crosses the Loop boundary outside its ports.
codes.CYCLE_OUTSIDE_LOOP: This connection closes a cycle. Use a Loop to repeat work.
codes.UNREACHABLE: The flow never reaches this node.
codes.NO_OUTPUT: The flow never reaches an Output.
codes.CAPABILITY_TARGET: Calls go from an agent to a callable agent.
codes.CAPABILITY_NOT_ALLOWED: The calling role is not allowed to make this call.
codes.DEPTH_EXCEEDED: This agent is only reachable beyond the delegation depth limit.
codes.BINDING_SOURCE: An input reads from a step that cannot provide it: {message}
codes.REVIEW_CONTRACT: A review decision must read a reviewer's output.
codes.UNKNOWN_MODEL_PROFILE: A role uses a model profile that is not configured.

Run.heading: Run
Run.requests: {count, plural, =0 {no model requests} one {# model request} other {# model requests}}
Run.outputPending: The output appears when the run finishes.
Run.notRunnable: Fix the problems listed under Before running to enable Run.
Run.notRunnableHere: This Corral is valid but uses steps this runtime cannot run yet.

Reins.heading: Reins
Reins.noTarget: Start a run and choose an execution to steer.
Reins.instructionHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
Reins.deliveredNote: Delivered means the instruction was included in a model request. It does not mean the model followed it.

receipt.queued: Waiting for the next model request
receipt.expired: Not delivered: the execution finished first

Reins.finished: This execution has finished. New instructions can no longer be delivered.
